channel.title: Wire — Databases
channel.description: Databases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: DocumentDB 1.0: A MongoDB-Compatible Document Database on Postgres
item.description: The first generally available release of DocumentDB, the MIT-licensed, MongoDB-compatible document database built on PostgreSQL. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: PGX: Run Thousands of Throwaway Databases in One Process
pgBackRest 2.60: Restores Now Stop on Invalid Page Checksums
item.description: The pgBackRest Releases detail each version of the software and lists the changes made in each version. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Twelve years of distributed SQLite
item.description: In September 2014 I published a short post announcing rqlite. The idea was simple: take SQLite, put a Raft log in front of it, and replicate every write to a cluster so that the loss of a node did not mean the loss of the data. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: CSIRO Uses Serverless Architecture to Query 100x More Genomic Variants on AWS
item.description: CSIRO has developed Serverless Beacon, a serverless architecture for querying genomic variants without copying VCF files into a central database. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: TypeScript 7.1 content mappers made type checks 20× faster
item.description: I created TypeSQL , a library that type-checks raw Postgres SQL inside TypeScript's type system, with no codegen and no database connection: const q = sql("SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = $1", 42); // ^? (1 source: rprogramming)
